scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate dev --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate status --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:diff: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --config prisma.config.ts --script
scripts.db:migrate:resolve:applied: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate resolve --config prisma.config.ts --applied
scripts.db:migrate:resolve:rollback: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate resolve --config prisma.config.ts --rolled-back
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma db seed --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/assert-local-database.mjs && npm run db:verify:migration-role && prisma migrate reset --force --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:smoke: node scripts/require-db-env.mjs DATABASE_URL DIRECT_URL && tsx scripts/verify-seed.ts && tsx scripts/verify-runtime-role.ts
